column1: # RFC-0203 P1.2 — ns anchors per host class (dated measurements; never a theorem, never in Lean).
# RFC-0204 P2.1 — dated supersession: an old row is NEVER deleted; the last column
# `superseded_by` carries (`<anchor-id> <YYYY-MM-DD>`) when the row was replaced by
# a newer measurement of the SAME class. One LIVE row (empty superseded_by,
# label quiet|DIAG) per class is the current anchor; `deferred` (RFC-0204 P2.2,
# 0203 vocabulary) marks a dated measurement debt (ns_value `-`), replaceable
# by the real measurement once the window exists.
# Columns (tab-separated): class  anchor_id  ns_value  date  host  label  source  superseded_by
#   class      HostIoClass constructor (WorkIo.lean): linux_fdatasync | darwin_fullfsync
#              (+ darwin_fdatasync: the G1 class on darwin, RFC-0036)
#   ns_value   u64 ns OR a documented phase pin `k=v;k=v` (per-op phase anchor);
#              `-` only on a deferred row
#   label      quiet | DIAG | deferred — honest, decided from the run's loadavg (see source)
#   source     path of the finding that records the measurement (must exist in the repo)
#   superseded_by  empty (live row) OR `<successor-anchor-id> <date>` — the successor
#              exists in the table, is the same class, and is measured (quiet/DIAG, never deferred)
# Consumed by the host anchor table test (dev tree: crates/pedradb-core/tests/host_anchor_table.rs —
# one measured LIVE row per class; coherent supersession without cycles; count multipliers
# class-independent — the any-class theorems of WorkIo.lean). Re-anchor rite: e.g.
# fullfsync_anchor --gate-quiet (exit 1 if loadavg ≥ threshold; prints a ready row).
